prompt: Build the unitary produced by: (1) the standard circuit (Hadamard on all 5 qubits, then the phase exp(-i*gamma*H) where H = 0.3*Z0*Z1 - 0.4*Z2*Z3 + 0.5*Z0*Z4, gamma = 0.45), followed by (2) the 5-qubit Quantum Fourier Transform (standard textbook definition: Hadamard and controlled-phase gates, followed by the final SWAP-reversal layer) applied to all 5 qubits. This circuit will be transpiled for a 5-qubit LINEAR coupling map (qubit i only physically adjacent to qubit i-1 and i+1) — the first two H terms are between adjacent qubits, the third (Z0*Z4) is between the two most distant qubits, so some routing overhead is expected. This is a general-purpose circuit block, not a fixed starting state. No measurement.
